2027-02-11.title: Thursday of the first week of the Great Fast · Our Lady of Lourdes
readings: Sarai, Hagar and a plan made without God
Your life is hidden with Christ in God
2027-02-11.alt: Great Fast (Valiya Nombu), first week. Memory of Our Lady of Lourdes; World Day of the Sick.
2027-02-11.verse: for he has looked with favor on the lowliness of his servant. Surely, from now on all generations will call me blessed;
theo: The reading from Genesis is painful and honest. Sarai, childless, decides to help God keep his promise in her own way: “go in to my slave-girl; it may be that I shall obtain children by her.” Abram agrees. Hagar conceives, contempt grows, Sarai blames Abram, and Abram washes his hands: “Your slave-girl is in your power; do to her as you please.” Sarai deals harshly with her, and the Egyptian slave runs away into the wilderness. A plan made without waiting on God ends with a household broken and the weakest person paying the price. Paul points to the opposite way: “seek the things that are above, where Christ is… Set your minds on things that are above, not on things that are on earth, for you have died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.”

The Gospel is Mary's song, the prayer of one who waited on God and let him act: “My soul magnifies the Lord, and my spirit rejoices in God my Savior, for he has looked with favor on the lowliness of his servant… He has brought down the powerful from their thrones, and lifted up the lowly.” On 11 February 1858, at the grotto of Massabielle near Lourdes, the Blessed Virgin appeared to Bernadette Soubirous, a poor and sickly girl of fourteen, the first of eighteen apparitions. On 25 March she named herself: “I am the Immaculate Conception.” At her word a spring was uncovered, and the sick have come to it ever since. Because of this, St John Paul II made 11 February the World Day of the Sick. Today the Lord again looks with favour on the lowly: on Hagar in the wilderness, on Bernadette, and on every sick person who prays to him with Mary.
outline: Ask: have you ever tried to make God's promise come true in your own way?
Point 1 · A plan made without God
Seek the things that are above.
Point 3 · He lifted up the lowly
Mary's song, Bernadette and the sick.
“He has looked with favor on the lowliness of his servant.”
live: Visit, call or pray by name for a sick person today.
Bring one decision you are rushing to God in prayer before acting.
2027-02-11.prayer: Holy Mother of God, Our Lady of Lourdes, you sang that the Lord looks with favour on the lowly. Pray for the sick, the suffering and those who care for them. Teach us to seek the things that are above, to wait on God instead of forcing our own plans, and to magnify the Lord in every circumstance. Lord Jesus, through her prayers heal us in body and soul. Amen.
altar: Mary magnified the Lord with her whole life; in the Holy Qurbono we join her song as we receive her Son.

quick: Sarai's plan made without God broke her household and hurt Hagar.
Our life is hidden with Christ in God; we seek the things above.
Mary sings that God lifts up the lowly; at Lourdes she came to a poor sick girl.
2027-02-11.action: Visit, call or pray by name for a sick person today.
2027-02-11.question: Where am I forcing my own plan instead of waiting on God?

family.explain: Mary sang a happy song because God loves the small and humble. At Lourdes, Mary appeared to a poor girl named Bernadette, and many sick people still go there to pray.
family.intention: We pray for all the sick people we know, by name.
family.ask: Ask: “Whom can we cheer up this week: a sick relative, a neighbour, an old friend?”

illus: A nurse from Changanassery working in a cancer ward abroad keeps a small bottle of Lourdes water in her pocket. She does not push it on anyone. But some nights, when a patient cannot sleep from fear, she asks quietly if they would like her to pray. Many say yes. She says the Magnificat in a whisper. She told her parish: I cannot cure them, but I can remind them that God looks with favour on the lowly.

pm.open: Holy Mary, Mother of God, with you we magnify the Lord. Pray for us and for all the sick. Amen.
share: It may be that I shall obtain children by her (Genesis 16:2). When have I run ahead of God?
Your life is hidden with Christ in God (Colossians 3:3). What does it mean for me to be hidden?
He has looked with favor on the lowliness of his servant (Luke 1:48). Do I believe God sees my lowliness?
pm.resp: Mother of God, pray for us.
interc: For the sick, especially those in hospital today.
For doctors, nurses and all who care for the sick.
For pilgrims to Lourdes and to our Marian shrines in Kerala.
For women who are treated harshly and run away from home.
For our parish, that we may keep the Fast in humility.
pm.close: Father, you looked with favour on the lowliness of Mary. Through her prayers, comfort the sick, lift up the lowly, and make us humble servants of your will. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

homily: Dear friends, Sarai tried to keep God's promise her own way. She gave Hagar to Abram, and the household broke: contempt, blame, harshness, and a slave-girl running into the wilderness (Genesis 16:2–6).
Paul shows a different way: set your minds on things that are above, not on things that are on earth, for you have died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God (Colossians 3:2–3).
Mary lived that way. She sang: he has looked with favor on the lowliness of his servant; he has brought down the powerful from their thrones, and lifted up the lowly (Luke 1:48, 52).

At Lourdes in 1858 she came to Bernadette, a poor sick girl, and the sick have gone there ever since. On this World Day of the Sick, let us pray for the sick, visit them, and magnify the Lord with Mary. Amen.
kids: Children, Mary sang a beautiful song: God loves the little ones! At Lourdes she came to a poor girl, Bernadette. Today, say a Hail Mary for someone who is sick.

intro: Theme: “He has looked with favor on the lowliness of his servant.”
A plan made without God, a life hidden with Christ, and the song of the lowly on the World Day of the Sick.

sub: Sarai runs ahead of the promise.
q: Wait for the Lord; be strong, and let your heart take courage; wait for the Lord!
Set your minds on things that are above, not on things that are on earth,
points.apply: Bring one hurried decision to God in prayer before acting.

q: You who live in the shelter of the Most High, who abide in the shadow of the Almighty,
for you have died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.
points.apply: Do one good deed today that no one will see.

sub: The sick are God's favoured ones.
q: He raises up the poor from the dust; he lifts the needy from the ash heap, to make them sit with princes and inherit a seat of honor.
He has brought down the powerful from their thrones, and lifted up the lowly;
points.apply: Visit or call a sick person this week.

concl: God's promises are kept in God's way and time.
He looks with favour on the lowly and the sick.
2027-02-11.resolve: Pray the Magnificat each evening of this week for the sick.
